| `modelValue`          | `string`               |          | `undefined`                                                 | Markdown source, Vue 3's own v-model prop. ⚠️ WITHOUT THIS, `v-model` ON THIS COMPONENT DOES NOTHING. Vue 3 compiles `v-model="x"` to `:modelValue` + `@update:modelValue`, so a component that only declares `value`/`input` never receives the prop and its emit is never heard — silently, with no warning, looking exactly like a component that works. `value` is kept as the public name (consumers depend on it) and both are accepted. `undefined` rather than `''` as the default is what distinguishes "not passed" from "passed as empty". |

### Events

| Name                | Payload | Description                                                                          |
| ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `input`             | —       | The value changed. Vue 2's v-model dialect, kept for existing consumers.             |
| `update:modelValue` | —       | The value changed. Vue 3's v-model dialect — what a plain `v-model` listens for.     |
| `update:mode`       | —       | v-model:mode emit so consumers can bind the layout mode.                             |
| `unknown-variables` | —       | The unknown variables in the text changed; empty when every variable is known again. |
